brand_identity.name: BROGRESSIVE 1 on 1 Online Coaching
brand_identity.tagline: Systematic Athletic Progression & Bodybuilding Elite Coaching
brand_identity.language: Indonesian (Layman Indonesian for Client View, Professional Technical for Coach/Admin)
brand_identity.aesthetic_archetype: Archetype 2: The Performance Pro (Tactical Athletic Dark Mode)

font_scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black uppercase tracking-tight leading-none
font_scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tight

colors.theme: Dark Mode Default with High-Contrast Athletic Accents

spacing_and_layout.padding_philosophy: Generous spacing system (p-6 to p-12 for containers) with strict internal padding to prevent collision
spacing_and_layout.bento_grid_mode: MODE B High Density for Dashboards / MODE A Tetris for Landing & Appearance Builder

client_easy_mode.primary_cta_above_fold: Single contextual action button (e.g., 'Mulai Latihan Hari Ini', 'Isi Check-in Mingguan')

landing_and_appearance_builder.structure: Pure React + Tailwind with customizable live preview engine (desktop + mobile viewport toggles)

workout_execution.layout: One exercise per screen with large progress indicator, exercise gif/video, set row table with Previous Weight/Reps, Target Weight/Reps, RPE/RIR badge, and Rest Timer popover
workout_execution.controls: Set completion toggle button with immediate visual feedback and haptic-style transition

nutrition_builder.calculator: Mifflin-St Jeor BMR calculator integrated with Activity Factor (1.2 to 1.9) and Goal Adjustment (Cut/Maintenance/Bulk)
nutrition_builder.macros: Protein (4 kcal/g), Carbs (4 kcal/g), Fats (9 kcal/g) visual pie/bar split with preset macro templates

checkin_wizard.uploader: Multi-angle photo preview card with zoom and side-by-side historical comparison

testing_and_accessibility.data_testid_rule: ALL interactive components (buttons, tabs, inputs, cards, check-in photos, chat items) MUST contain unique, descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='client-bottom-nav-hari-ini', data-testid='start-workout-cta')
testing_and_accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text on dark surface
testing_and_accessibility.hover_focus_states: Focus ring 2px #FF2E00 with explicit text contrast setting on hover

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the dark tactical athletic aesthetic using #0A0A0C base and #FF2E00 primary accent.
Implement Client Easy Mode as DEFAULT view when role is 'client', featuring fixed bottom nav with 5 items: Hari Ini, Program, Catat, Progres, Coach.
Ensure all interactive elements have data-testid attributes in kebab-case.
Do not use generic Inter font for headings; use Barlow Condensed or Bebas Neue font classes for strong athletic impact.
Use Indonesian language for client interactions ('Latihan Hari Ini', 'Hitung Makro', 'Upload Foto Progres').
Ensure appearance builder provides real-time desktop and mobile canvas toggle previews.
